root_motivation: WHO: the coding agent whose user asks whether the host's logs hold their customers' emails, the EU customer, and Joe answering a deletion request. WHAT: secrets are redacted wherever the host stores tool output, but an `email` argument reaches call_traces, calls.error_summary, runs.error_data_json and (http) the logs table as sent, and nothing enumerates the sinks. WHY NOW: the posture cannot claim log minimisation, and a deletion request cannot be honoured for these sinks.
user_persona: A tool publisher who tags the argument names that carry personal data on host.tool.publish and needs every persisted sink of tool output to show [redacted:pii] instead, with a test that fails when a new sink is written without the registry.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a python tool published without `pii` that prints its `email` argument and raises on it, When called with `email: "a@b.io"`, Then `call_traces` (request, output tails, error) and `calls.error_summary` hold `a@b.io` and the test prints which; if no persisted sink holds it the build stops with `premise_false`.

Given the same tool published with `pii: ["email"]`, When called, and called again as an async run, Then every sink of `LogSink` shows `[redacted:pii]` where the untagged call held `a@b.io`, none holds `a@b.io`, the caller's `result` still contains it, and a `host.call_trace` replay refuses naming `email`.

Given a tool schema with `phone` and without `nope`, When `host.tool.publish` runs with `pii: ["nope"]`, Then `args_invalid` names it; with `"x-pii": true` on `phone`, Then `host.tool.list` shows `pii_args: ["phone"]`; Given a republish without `pii`, Then the list is kept, and with `pii: []` it is cleared.

Given an http tool whose upstream echoes the request in a 500 body, When called with a tagged value, plain and percent-encoded in the body, Then the call's `logs` line, `call_traces.error_json`, `calls.error_summary` and (async) `runs.error_data_json` show `[redacted:pii]` and hold neither form.

Given the source tree, When `piir_sinks_cover_every_write` runs, Then every write into a sink table or column is in a function named in the `LogSink` table or in an allowlist entry with a reason; Given a planted `INSERT INTO logs` outside both, Then the test fails naming the file and line.
Given two tagged values where one contains the other, When redacted, Then the longer is replaced first and no partial value survives; Given a value of 2 characters, Then it stays intact.

Given the `LogSink` enum, When the no-drift test runs, Then the sink list in the generated contract equals the `Display` names of every enum variant, no sink is listed twice, and a variant added without regenerating the contract fails the test.

Given prod after deploy, When `tests/piir_ac08_live_prod_pii_redacted_in_call_trace.rs` calls a python tool tagged `pii: ["email"]` that prints and raises on `email`, Then `host.call_trace` shows `request.email` as `***`, `[redacted:pii]` in the tails and error, and no value.
acceptance_criteria.test: deferred: Live (prod; evidence: MCPHOST_LIVE=1 MCPHOST_URL=https://mcphost.dev cargo test --test piir_ac08_live_prod_pii_redacted_in_call_trace)

scope: src/logsink.rs (LogSink, write_through, PiiSet, task-local, ALLOWLIST); src/calltrace.rs (Redactor::with_pii, scrub, replay refusal on the marker); src/db.rs (tools.pii_args_json, the sink writers pass write_through); src/control.rs (tool_publish pii/x-pii merge, tool_list pii_args); src/handler.rs, src/runs.rs (per-call scope armed with the tagged values); src/paged.rs, src/api_contract.rs (log_sinks); migrations/0141_tool_pii_args.sql; contracts and generated docs; tests/piir_ac*.rs and tests/support/piir.rs.
non_goals: Redacting the tool's own result that goes back to the caller; detecting personal data without a tag; secrets; runs.args_json and queue_items.item_json; pruning logs; host.catalog.get and host.tool.spec_shared pii_args (R6); admin.pii_report (R7); the AC 8 prod read (operator-provisioned).

additional.one_migration: One nullable tools.pii_args_json column, compat: previous, at the next free number; no table rebuild.
additional.redaction_at_the_sink: Redaction attaches to LogSink writers, never to call sites; the source scan is the contract between the sink set and the code that writes it.

five_whys_trace.q: Why can a deletion request not be honoured for tool output?
five_whys_trace.a: An email argument is stored as sent in call_traces, calls.error_summary, runs.error_data_json and the logs table.

five_whys_trace.q: Why is it stored as sent?
five_whys_trace.a: Redaction exists only for secret values and secret-looking keys; personal data has no tag the host can read.

five_whys_trace.q: Why not add redaction at each writer as it is found?
five_whys_trace.a: Nothing enumerates where tool output is written, so a redaction added today misses the next sink.

five_whys_trace.q: Why is a registry plus a drift test the fix?
five_whys_trace.a: The source scan makes a new unregistered write fail CI, so the sink set cannot grow silently.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Redact the caller-facing result?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: No: it is what the caller asked for; AC 2 asserts it still contains the value.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Minimum value length 3 or 4?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: 3, one below the secret redactor's floor; numbers of fewer than 3 digits are never redacted.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Which messages sites run inside a tool call?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: insert_message is the one writer a tool call reaches and passes the sink; the five host-authored notice writers are allowlisted with reasons.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Does `pii: []` clear a property that carries x-pii?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Yes: an explicit empty list clears the stored set outright; without `pii`, x-pii properties join the kept names.
